functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Estimation of DNAm age per cohort (pooled across nodes)

databases.name: Beta/M values
databases.description: Dataframe of the IDAT extraction (Beta values per probe and sample)

arguments.name: clock_set
arguments.description: Which clocks to calculate. The sets are taken from the clocks in the image and leave out clocks needing inputs this algorithm does not provide. Clocks named below are added; choose 'Only the clocks listed below' to calculate just those. What each clock predicts: docs/clocks.md.

arguments.name: lista_relojes
arguments.description: Optional: clocks to add by name, e.g. horvath2013 (see docs/clocks.md for the 142 clocks). Delete the empty row if you only use a clock set.

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result (at least 2). Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: age_column
arguments.description: Column with the chronological age of each sample (e.g. 'age' from the IDAT extraction). Used to report the age acceleration, predicted minus chronological age; leave empty to skip.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Hospitals (organizations) to use; empty = all of the collaboration

arguments.name: reference_cohort
arguments.description: Cohort the others are compared with (age acceleration and age-adjusted comparisons). Empty: the first cohort in alphabetical order.

arguments.name: bin_width
arguments.description: Width of the bins of the age distributions and of the chronological-age bins of the calibration. Default 2.

arguments.name: min_bin_count
arguments.description: A bin with fewer samples at a hospital is not reported (at least 3). Default 5.

ui_visualizations.name: Epigenetic age per cohort
ui_visualizations.description: Mean predicted age, chronological age and age acceleration per clock and cohort. coverage_pct_min / max: share (%) of the clock's CpGs present, over the hospitals that contributed

ui_visualizations.name: Clock accuracy
ui_visualizations.description: How close each clock's predicted age is to the chronological age, over all samples with an age (best clock first): mean absolute error in years and correlation

ui_visualizations.name: Clock coverage
ui_visualizations.description: Share (%) of each clock's CpGs present in the data: lowest and highest over the hospitals. EPIC v2 lacks some clock CpGs and pyaging fills them in; there is no threshold, judge whether the coverage is enough. predicts / unit / year / citation: what the clock estimates and its publication

ui_visualizations.name: Cohort comparison (age acceleration)
ui_visualizations.description: Each cohort minus the reference cohort in mean age acceleration (predicted minus chronological age), with 95% CI and Welch p-value; p_adjusted: Benjamini-Hochberg over the clocks. The clocks are correlated, so they do not confirm each other independently

ui_visualizations.name: Age-adjusted comparison
ui_visualizations.description: Difference in predicted age between each cohort and the reference at the same chronological age (linear regression predicted age ~ chronological age + cohort), with 95% CI, p-value and Benjamini-Hochberg p over the clocks; age_slope: years of predicted age per year of chronological age

ui_visualizations.name: Age distribution
ui_visualizations.description: Samples per bin of predicted age and of age acceleration, per cohort and clock. A bin with fewer than the minimum samples at a hospital is not reported; n_not_shown counts those samples

ui_visualizations.name: Calibration
ui_visualizations.description: Per clock and chronological-age bin: mean chronological and predicted age, SD of the predicted age and their mean difference (bins with at least the minimum samples at a hospital)

ui_visualizations.name: Notes
ui_visualizations.description: How the cohorts were compared, and caveats
